title: tanacetum pinnatifidum
intro: Tanacetum pinnatifidum, commonly known as Mountain Tansy, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever reduction, digestive problems, and as a natural remedy for insect bites. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. Bioactive constituents present in Tanacetum pinnatifidum include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
